QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Explosives Strictly Prohibited
QuestInfo.0: You hear that Sheriff Lita received reports of illegal explosive devices. Meet up with her and see what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: Sheriff Lita asks you to get rid of Boomers, which are threatening the city and its surrounding areas. Get rid of the Boomer monsters before they can explode and cause untold damage.
QuestInfo.2: You took out the Boomers, proving yourself a great help to Lita.

mob.0: If you go out to the East side of the city, you'll see the Boomers. Then, it's just a matter of taking out about 100 or so.
